key_evidence_spans: A 47-year-old woman reported a 1-year history of persistent foreign body sensation in her right eye
A linear, soft-tissue lesion was noted centrally along the lower conjunctival fornix of the right eye
the mass appeared pinkish-yellow rather than the typical salmon pink of lymphoid lesions
Orbital computed tomography demonstrated a purely conjunctival, homogeneous mass isodense to muscle without infiltration of adjacent structures
Routine blood tests, including complete blood count and serum chemistry, were unremarkable
